list.name: Copilot Adopted
list.rawSql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE('2025-12-12','%Y-%m-%d') as time, 'GitHub Copilot Adopted' as text, 'copilot' as tags

description: Track engineering productivity gains from AI adoption. Copilot data available from Dec 2025.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(loc_added_sum)/NULLIF(SUM(loc_suggested_to_add_sum),0)*100,1) AS 'Copilot Acceptance %'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE day >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT SUM(loc_added_sum) AS 'LOC Accepted (30d)'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE day >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_date, merged_date)),1) AS 'Avg Merge Time (hrs)'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND merged_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'PRs Merged (30d)'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND merged_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Commits (30d)'
FROM commits
WHERE authored_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS 'Active Sentry Bugs'
FROM issues
WHERE type = 'BUG' AND status != 'DONE' AND resolution_date IS NULL
  AND created_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  SUM(loc_suggested_to_add_sum) as 'LOC Suggested'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  SUM(loc_added_sum) as 'LOC Accepted'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

panels.title: Copilot Daily LOC — Suggested vs Accepted

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  ROUND(SUM(loc_added_sum)/NULLIF(SUM(loc_suggested_to_add_sum),0)*100, 1) as 'Acceptance Rate %'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(day, '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT login) as 'Active Users'
FROM _tool_copilot_user_daily_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter(day)
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

panels.description: Weekly commit volume. Copilot adopted Dec 2025 (vertical annotation).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(authored_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(authored_date) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(*) as 'Commits'
FROM commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(authored_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  DATE(authored_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(authored_date) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT author_email) as 'Active Authors'
FROM commits
WHERE $__timeFilter(authored_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Weekly Commits & Active Authors

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(created_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(created_date) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(*) as 'PRs Opened'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  DATE(merged_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(merged_date) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(*) as 'PRs Merged'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  DATE(merged_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(merged_date) DAY) as time,
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_date, merged_date)), 1) as 'Avg Merge Time (hrs)'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Weekly PRs Opened, Merged & Cycle Time

panels.description: Average PR merge time by month. A declining trend after Dec 2025 indicates AI is accelerating code review.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_date, merged_date)), 1) as 'Avg Merge Time (hrs)',
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_date, merged_date)) * 0.75, 1) as 'P75 Estimate'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Monthly PR Merge Time Trend

panels.description: Average PR size (additions) per month. AI may help write more focused, smaller PRs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  ROUND(AVG(additions)) as 'Avg Additions',
  ROUND(AVG(deletions)) as 'Avg Deletions'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND additions IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Monthly Avg PR Size (Lines)

panels.description: Distribution of PR sizes. Smaller PRs are easier to review and merge faster.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN additions < 50 THEN 'XS (<50)'
    WHEN additions < 200 THEN 'S (50-200)'
    WHEN additions < 500 THEN 'M (200-500)'
    WHEN additions < 1000 THEN 'L (500-1k)'
    ELSE 'XL (1k+)'
  END as 'PR Size',
  COUNT(*) as 'Count'
FROM pull_requests
WHERE merged_date IS NOT NULL AND additions IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY FIELD(`PR Size`, 'XS (<50)', 'S (50-200)', 'M (200-500)', 'L (500-1k)', 'XL (1k)')

panels.title: PR Size Distribution

panels.description: Summary of completed and active Linear sprints/cycles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  c.name as 'Cycle',
  DATE_FORMAT(c.starts_at, '%m/%d/%Y') as 'Start',
  DATE_FORMAT(c.ends_at, '%m/%d/%Y') as 'End',
  COUNT(i.id) as 'Total Issues',
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.state_type = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'Completed',
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.state_type = 'started' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'In Progress',
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.state_type IN ('backlog','triage') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'Backlog',
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.state_type = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(i.id),0) * 100, 0) as 'Completion %',
  CASE WHEN c.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN '✅ Done' ELSE '🔄 Active' END as 'Status'
FROM _tool_linear_cycles c
LEFT JOIN _tool_linear_issues i ON i.cycle_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.starts_at, c.ends_at, c.completed_at
ORDER BY c.starts_at DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Linear Sprint / Cycle Summary

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(created_at - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(created_at) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(*) as 'Issues Created'
FROM _tool_linear_issues
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  DATE(completed_at - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(completed_at) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(*) as 'Issues Completed'
FROM _tool_linear_issues
WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Distribution of issue cycle times (hours from creation to completion).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, completed_at)), 1) as 'Avg Close Time (hrs)',
  ROUND(MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, completed_at)), 1) as 'Min Close Time (hrs)'
FROM _tool_linear_issues
WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(completed_at)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Linear Issue Close Time Trend

panels.description: Issues by priority. High priority bugs should decrease as AI helps catch issues earlier.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(priority_label, 'No Priority') as 'Priority',
  state_type as 'State',
  COUNT(*) as 'Count'
FROM _tool_linear_issues
GROUP BY priority_label, state_type
ORDER BY priority, state_type

panels.title: Linear Issues by Priority & State

panels.description: Sentry bugs opened per month. A declining trend indicates improving code quality from AI adoption.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  COUNT(*) as 'New Sentry Bugs',
  SUM(CASE WHEN resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'Resolved'
FROM issues
WHERE type = 'BUG' AND $__timeFilter(created_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_date, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Monthly Sentry Bugs Opened vs Resolved

panels.description: Rootly incidents over time with MTTR. Lower incidents and faster resolution indicates more stable deployments.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  title as 'Title',
  status as 'Status',
  DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as 'Created',
  DATE_FORMAT(resolved_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as 'Resolved',
  ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, COALESCE(resolved_at, NOW())) / 60.0, 1) as 'MTTR (hrs)'
FROM _tool_rootly_incidents
ORDER BY created_at DESC

panels.title: Rootly Incidents

panels.description: Production deployments per week. More frequent deployments with low failure rate indicate CI/CD maturity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE(finished_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(finished_date) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) as 'Successful Deploys'
FROM cicd_deployment_commits
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE pm.project_name = 'renew-platform'
  AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  AND result = 'SUCCESS'
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  DATE(finished_date - INTERVAL WEEKDAY(finished_date) DAY) as time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) as 'Failed Deploys'
FROM cicd_deployment_commits
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE pm.project_name = 'renew-platform'
  AND environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  AND result = 'FAILURE'
  AND $__timeFilter(finished_date)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Weekly Production Deployments (Success vs Failure)

panels.description: Lead time from PR merge to production. Shorter lead time = faster value delivery.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') as time,
  ROUND(AVG(ppm.pr_cycle_time) / 3600.0, 2) as 'Avg Lead Time (hrs)'
FROM project_pr_metrics ppm
JOIN pull_requests pr ON ppm.id = pr.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
JOIN cicd_deployment_commits cdc ON ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc.id
WHERE pm.project_name = 'renew-platform'
  AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND ppm.pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m-01')
ORDER BY time
